consulting.title: Consulting
consulting.summary: Independent assignments in instrumentation, prompt engineering, classification, data analysis and Python integration.

highlights.label: Instrumentation
highlights.value: Automated epifluorescence microscope and autofocus algorithm

highlights.label: Other assignments
highlights.value: Prompt engineering, classification and data analysis

paragraphs: I carried out an assignment as an independent technical consultant for Vidya Health Ltd from April to November 2020. This work, covered by a confidentiality agreement, concerned the development of an automated epifluorescence microscope.
Since 2023, I have also occasionally carried out independent consulting, training and technical integration assignments. These activities are currently paused.

directContributions.label: Instrumentation
directContributions.text: Contributed to the development of an automated epifluorescence microscope.

directContributions.label: Development
directContributions.text: Developed and deployed the solution with LabVIEW.

directContributions.label: Occasional assignments
directContributions.text: Consulting and training in prompt engineering, classification, data analysis and Python integration.

scientific-research.title: Scientific research
scientific-research.summary: Occasional continuation of scientific collaborations and work associated with MLLPA.

paragraphs: Some scientific collaborations were occasionally continued alongside my main professional activities.
This work is notably associated with MLLPA, a Python module dedicated to machine-learning-assisted analysis of lipid-membrane phases.

directContributions.label: Collaboration
directContributions.text: Occasionally continued work with scientific collaborators.

directContributions.label: Software development
directContributions.text: Continued work associated with MLLPA, for which I developed approximately 95% of the code.

directContributions.label: Documentation
directContributions.text: Continued work associated with the MLLPA website and documentation, which I originally created in full.

directContributions.label: Machine learning
directContributions.text: Occasionally continued work related to lipid-membrane analysis and the three-dimensional CNN developed with TensorFlow.

teaching.title: Teaching
teaching.summary: Teaching in physics and chemistry, statistical thermodynamics, AI, machine learning, deep learning and Python.

highlights.label: Secondary education
highlights.value: Five contracts or teaching placements between 2008 and 2013

paragraphs: My teaching activity covers physics and chemistry, statistical thermodynamics, artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning and Python.
It has taken place in secondary education, engineering school and university, with audiences ranging from lower-secondary-school pupils to Master’s-level engineering students.

directContributions.label: King’s College London
directContributions.text: Designed the statistical-thermodynamics programme and teaching materials in full, then taught the course in English to approximately one hundred third-year chemistry students between January and June 2023.

directContributions.label: ECPM — University of Strasbourg
directContributions.text: Taught artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning and Python to three cohorts of approximately thirty Master’s-level engineering students between 2021 and 2023.

directContributions.label: Secondary education
directContributions.text: Completed five intermittent contracts or teaching placements in physics and chemistry at lower- and upper-secondary-school level between 2008 and 2013.
